title: 二级圆柱齿轮减速器 WQR-105（整机）
summary: 整台减速器：传动比分配、两级齿轮、三根轴和六个轴承、轴向布置、箱体热平衡（有限元）、三维装配，再在减速器厂合箱镗孔、装配、跑合、出厂 10 台。
summary_en: The complete reducer: ratio split, both gear stages, three shafts and six bearings, axial layout, housing heat balance (FEA), 3D assembly, then line-boring, assembly, run-in and dispatch of 10 units in the gearbox plant.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 4 kW、1450 r/min 输入，350 N·m、138.1 r/min 输出，i = 10.5；油温 ≤ 80 ℃；输出轴和低速级齿轮用案例 A、B 的结果。
steps.summary_en: 4 kW at 1450 rpm in, 350 N·m at 138.1 rpm out, i = 10.5; oil ≤ 80 °C; output shaft and low-speed gears from cases A and B.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 比较四种传动比分配：总中心距差不到 4%，差在浸油；现行 3 × 3.5 低速级大齿轮浸油 0.42 倍半径略深，但工装和 A、B 已定，保持不变，下一代改 i₁ > i₂。
steps.summary_en: Four ratio splits compared: total centre distance within 4%, the difference is oil immersion; the current 3 × 3.5 dips the low-speed wheel 0.42 of its radius, slightly deep, but tooling and cases A/B are fixed, so it is kept; next generation should use i₁ > i₂.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 两级齿轮 S_H 1.14 / 1.12；轴承跨距要从案例 A 的 115 加到 136 mm；三根轴最小 S_ca 3.35；轴承最短寿命 11,758 h。
steps.summary_en: Gear stages S_H 1.14 / 1.12; bearing span must grow from case A's 115 to 136 mm; lowest shaft S_ca 3.35; shortest bearing life 11,758 h.

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 光箱体满载油温约 88 ℃，超 80 ℃；每侧 8 条散热筋后约 73 ℃（有限元 65 ℃）；输出轴按新跨距复核 S_ca 1.71。
steps.summary_en: Plain housing runs at about 88 °C, above 80 °C; with 8 fins per side about 73 °C (FEA 65 °C); output shaft rechecked at the new span, S_ca 1.71.

figs.caption: 箱体热平衡：有限元与教材公式
figs.caption_en: Housing heat balance: FEA and textbook formula

figs.caption: 加散热筋后箱体外表面温度（有限元）

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: 三根轴、四只齿轮、六只轴承按新布置装成三维；装配示意图标出跨距 136 mm；物料清单 17 行。
steps.summary_en: Three shafts, four gears and six bearings assembled in 3D to the new layout; layout sketch with the 136 mm span; 17-line BOM.

figs.caption: WQR-105 内部三维（不含箱体）

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 5 个部件 / 产品、13 道装配工序；合箱镗孔保证中心距；跨距改了，箱体、输出轴、中间轴一起改版。
steps.summary_en: Five assemblies, 13 operations; line-boring holds the centre distances; with the new span the housing, output and intermediate shafts are revised together.

tools.label: 工艺规程与 AI 评审

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 五张工单各 10 套 / 台完工；跑合起动峰值 1.58–1.69 倍额定；标准成本 $591.57/台。
steps.summary_en: Five work orders of 10 completed; run-in start-up peaks 1.58–1.69× rated; standard cost $591.57 per unit.

figs.caption: 10 台跑合的起动峰值与运行平均转矩
figs.caption_en: Run-in start-up peaks and running mean torque of 10 units

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 9 / 9 项校核通过；整机反过来改了零件：跨距 115 → 136、箱体加筋。
steps.summary_en: 9 / 9 checks pass; the whole machine changed its parts: span 115 → 136, housing fins.
